name: L&L Hawaiian Barbecue
notes: DoorDash's JSON-LD for this store (2850 National Ave, matches batch exactly) was a confirmed PARTIAL capture: only 8 of ~18 nav-listed categories (73 dishes), missing core sections like Local Favorites, A la Carte, King's Hawaiian Sandwiches/Burgers, Healthier Plates, Saimin, Keiki Plates, Desserts, Poke. Uber Eats' own JSON-LD for the same address (redirected slug l&l-hawaiian-barbecue-28th-st, matching the batch's own website URL .../locations/28th-street/) covered all 18 categories with 129 unique dishes, so it was used as the primary source instead. Cent-distribution is scattered with no dominant markup divisor (genuine pricing, delivery-platform-typical upcharge baked in). A few items sit under oddly-named platform sections (Rewards_LP, Packages, Thursday Specials) but are legitimate priced menu items (loyalty-reward plates, catering packs, a weekly special) kept as-is.

name: Garbatella
notes: Own Toast ordering page; address (2015 Birch Road STE 2500, Chula Vista, CA 91915) matches batch exactly. name: Gregorio's Restaurant
notes: Own first-party website (domain matches batch). Fetched page text bundles MULTIPLE menu tabs concatenated together (Dinner Menu, Banquet Menu, Buffet Menu, Desserts, Children's Menu, Happy Hour); only the Dinner Menu tab (text before the 'Children's Menu Ages 10 & under' boundary) was filed here as the standard dine-in/order menu -- Banquet/Buffet/Catering-tray/Kids/Happy-Hour pricing was excluded as out of scope. The page renders item name + description + price as a continuous text stream with no machine-readable delimiter; a generic name/description-split parser worked for most sections but broke on the Soups (Cup/Bowl) and Thin Crust Pizzas (Individual/Large) size-variant sections, so this final dish list was hand-transcribed directly from the raw source text for accuracy, with each size variant filed as a separate dish entry (name suffixed with the size). A market-price 'Seasonal Fresh Catch' listing with no fixed price was dropped per the no-invented-prices rule.
